audit.head: 3b30cfb6507183e16506452b082101c31d213c10
audit.activity: Read-only code and AGENTS.md inspection. No repository edits, test execution, provider/model/API/browser calls.
audit.call_count_definition: Calls to ModelPort.structured made by these brain modules; provider-adapter retries/degrades are outside these bounds.
audit.limits: Static inventory is not execution evidence, semantic-quality evaluation, persistence confirmation or completion proof.

operations.responsibility: Owned research subject -> 1-4 grounded, concise, distinct retrieval hypotheses; no finding/advice.
operations.healthy_calls: 1 per fitting nonempty subject batch; 0 for no subjects
operations.recovery_bound: At most 2 calls per batch, with second restricted to unread subject IDs. SchemaViolation/OutputTruncated retry; ContextOverflow stops unit; other ModelError stops remaining batches as outage.
operations.input: Complete attributed conversation; each subject with owner/scope/purpose/question/record IDs and attributed material.
operations.output: ResearchResult.rows[subject_id]=tuple(query text); per-subject coverage plus optional outage.

operations.responsibility: Supplied exact legal passages -> candidate findings; no model-memory law.
operations.healthy_calls: 1 per active passage-bearing subject batch; 0 for subjects with no hits, unavailable search, or no active subjects.
operations.recovery_bound: At most 2 calls per batch, only unread subject IDs; same error handling as decompose_disputes.
operations.input: Full conversation; subjects; exact candidate passages; exclusive per-subject allowed_source_ids and allowed_material_ids.
operations.output: Proposal rows include copied exact selected source objects and mentioned/not_mentioned status. Search partial/unavailable remains visible.

operations.responsibility: Independently admit each complete candidate only after provenance/entailment/application/force checks.
operations.healthy_calls: 1 per fitting nonempty candidate batch; 0 when no candidate atoms.
operations.recovery_bound: At most 2 calls per batch, only unread candidate IDs. Malformed review/OutputTruncated retry; substantive unsupported/uncertain verdict is final withholding, not a retry request; ContextOverflow stops unit; ModelError/downgrade becomes outage.
operations.input: Full attributed source-spanned conversation; per-candidate subject/material; exact legal fragments; independently classified substantive advocate account catalogue.
operations.output: Retained original findings with exact code-resolved source/use verification research_support_v6 and application references; rejected_findings and coverage diagnostics separately.

operations.responsibility: Compose one source-linked request unit with proposals/sufficiency/work selection/progress.
operations.healthy_calls: 1 writer plus 1 independent verify_continuation call for nonempty mechanically valid result.
operations.recovery_bound: At most 2 writer calls. One complete replacement for mechanically invalid or semantically rejected units; accepted peers excluded. Independent unread units removed from writer retry. SchemaViolation/OutputTruncated use replacement; ContextOverflow propagates; other ModelError/downgrade stops writing.
operations.input: Full exact attributed transcript/latest message; provisional work; owned current derived record; checked current legal uses/coverage; saved tasks/questions; material execution evidence preserved inside coverage.
operations.output: Resolved admitted/limited units with source_aware_continuation_v1 marker; per-request ok/partial/unavailable coverage. No persistence in this module.

operations.responsibility: Independently judge every exact displayed block, proposal identity, selected work, progress and affected question; certify useful factual subset where safe.
operations.output_tokens: max(4096,min(8192,256*checks)); checks=sum(2+blocks+questions+next_work+progress_updates) for pending units. question_resolutions are not included in this cap formula.
operations.recovery_bound: At most 2 calls per invocation, only unread/malformed verdict units. Semantic reject is a completed verdict. SchemaViolation retries; OutputTruncated falls through ModelError and stops without retry. ContextOverflow propagates; other ModelError/downgrade stops.
operations.input: Entire continuation input payload under input; only pending proposed units; second call adds validation_issues.
operations.output: Decisions bool/reason, unavailable request IDs, certified retained block IDs. No rewritten prose or updates are generated.

operations.tier: caller supplied; default routine; judge explicitly forbids downgrade
operations.system: Caller system plus generic repair suffix on attempt 2 only
operations.responsibility: Generic complete schema/accept-function validation with one correction.
operations.recovery_bound: At most 2 structured calls. Only SchemaViolation, including accept callback violations, triggers correction. OutputTruncated/ContextOverflow/TierUnavailable/other ModelError propagate.
operations.input: Caller exact prompt/schema; correction original_input is decoded original JSON.
operations.output: Only callback-accepted typed value. No storage.

dynamic_prompt_additions.trigger: Second per-batch attempt with unread subject/candidate IDs and precise issues.
dynamic_prompt_additions.system_addition: Message: same research activity; valid peers retained. Purpose: repair only supplied failures under same contract. Look for: issues/original attributed input/selected exact words; rejected output not evidence. Outcome: complete replacements only unresolved IDs, no peer repeat or invented support.
dynamic_prompt_additions.context_projection: Only unresolved atomic units are rebundled; full attributed conversation and their complete material/passages retained. No original conversation trim.
dynamic_prompt_additions.removal_or_terminal: No rejected-output removal here. If correction no longer fits full context, stop unresolved units as partial.

dynamic_prompt_additions.trigger: First SchemaViolation from call usability/schema/accept callback.
dynamic_prompt_additions.system_addition: Four explicit Message/Purpose/Look for/Outcome sections: prior read rejected and unsaved; repair issue; use original attributed source words; complete supported replacement under same schema.
dynamic_prompt_additions.how_to_correct: Full same-schema object; allowed source refs/classifications only; omit unsupported proposals; named saved-item links require intended target with required source IDs or removal/correction.
dynamic_prompt_additions.context_projection: First preserves original input plus rejected data; if too large, removes only rejected_output. Second overflow raises ContextOverflow; original input is never trimmed.
dynamic_prompt_additions.preflight: estimate_tokens(repair_system+repair_user)+output_limit <= model.context_budget(tier); encoded schema not included in this helper preflight.

dynamic_prompt_additions.trigger: Second writer attempt for pending malformed or semantically rejected request units.
dynamic_prompt_additions.system_addition: Four explicit sections: rejected units unreleased; resolve issue without reassessing accepted peers; compare rejection with claims/questions/references/full conversation and discard mistaken premise; complete replacements, truthful specific limits if unsupported.
user_additions: correction.rejected_units filtered to pending requests when available
dynamic_prompt_additions.context_projection: work_items reduced to pending request indexes; all remaining original input and catalogues preserved. Accepted peer progress targets reserved in code.

user_additions: output_budget_guidance: concise complete units; combine compatible claims, avoid repeated account/limitations, retain essential source references.
dynamic_prompt_additions.effect: Double pending-unit base output cap, bounded at 16384; no third writer call and no conversation trim.

dynamic_prompt_additions.trigger: Second review attempt for unread/malformed verdicts only.
user_additions: validation_issues list of request_index and issue
dynamic_prompt_additions.context_projection: All input_payload stays under input; units only unresolved request indexes. Rejected review output itself is not supplied.
dynamic_prompt_additions.budget_change: Recomputed from pending units, no truncation-specific expansion.

dynamic_prompt_additions.trigger: After bounded writer loop, last writer result has local _ContentFailure on otherwise checked identities/references/graph, no already accepted/certified retained unit, and a factual subset plus displayed limitation survives.
dynamic_prompt_additions.system_addition: None: ordinary verify_continuation static prompt reused.
user_additions: input.partial_response_review: original unreleased unit and content issues per narrowed request
dynamic_prompt_additions.unit_projection: Remove excluded failed blocks, proposal-owned blocks, legal/advice/question/completion blocks; retain only acknowledgment/account/limitation with at least one factual block and specific limitation. Clear questions,next_work,progress_updates; sufficiency partial; preserve exact surviving text and work association.
dynamic_prompt_additions.handoff: Mechanical _validate_unit first, then independently review complete narrowed meaning; only positive verdict or certified further subset enters retained output.
dynamic_prompt_additions.extra_call_bound: Up to 2 judge calls beyond writer-loop reviews; zero new writer calls.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Downgraded judge result raises TierUnavailable; no silent promotion to independent acceptance.

Unique subject owner/scope/question and record IDs; no conflicting attributed record identity; subject references available; general scope none cannot import matter material; original turn/role/text must be attributable.
gate_ownership_and_projections.semantic_owner: Models decide question/material relevance and law meaning; code enforces supplied ownership.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Full system+JSON input+encoded schema+output cap must fit tier budget.
gate_ownership_and_projections.projection: Fewest consecutive fitting complete atomic units; oversized units partial/unread; no original transcript/source truncation.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Nonempty short label/need/why; force compatible with finding kind; unique source IDs strictly within this subject; unique material IDs within same attributed record.
gate_ownership_and_projections.handoff: Copies actual selected retrieved source objects into proposals; model source labels never create passages.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: All research subjects present; valid complete candidate meaning; exact source-ID/object ownership/kind/locator/text; only independently classified substantive advocate spans eligible for factual application.
gate_ownership_and_projections.projection: Server temporary candidate IDs r1...; exact source passages split into complete 700-character fragments with 140 overlap [902,912]; separately numbered per source.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Accepted finding needs faithful label, supported entailment/application/force, supported basis; exact complete checks of cited sources/material; adopted operative owner/role/treatment; same-source fragments; at least one retained source; use checks only retained refs; exact qualified account-supported premises.
gate_ownership_and_projections.projection: Drop material links checked does_not_address/uncertain and sources checked unsupported/uncertain; preserve candidate text and required existing conditions; resolve original selected fragments and advocate references in code.
gate_ownership_and_projections.false_positive_boundary: Semantic rejection can omit unused source/material/premise checks; conditional/general findings may have no material links; required force forbidden for limited analogy; fully empty candidate set invokes no semantic reviewer.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Complete conversation, attributed latest turn, reliable saved work/records/context, current verified legal uses and exact owner mappings.
gate_ownership_and_projections.projection: Full exact source catalogue; derived disputes/material marked nm_interpretation; held uncertain material kept outside active fact catalogue; current verified requirement/research uses remapped to owner-bound hashed legal IDs; historical/stale legal uses not promoted; source classifications retained separately; work choices supplied per intent.
gate_ownership_and_projections.handoff: Writer and reviewer receive same full input; material_coverage (including code receipt if supplied) copied unchanged.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: One server-supplied work_selector derives existing/create fields; request cannot omit its task association, contribution cannot invent requested task; dynamic owned ID enums and empty inapplicable arrays.
gate_ownership_and_projections.false_positive_reduction: Avoid redundant model work fields; no legal sources means no assessment kind; enum union is narrowed again by per-request code check.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Exact unique block/proposal identity, owned references, inline anchors, exact displayed purpose owners, supported attributed progress, one target owner across units and accepted peers; task/full-scope vs reply sufficiency separate.
mechanical_normalization: Validate every proposal target first, then deduplicate idempotent target_ids [799,801].
Bind already selected advocate progress spans to exact owner block [383,395].
Selecting an owned checked finding adds its existing legal-source mapping [744,754].
Opaque catalogue IDs in prose exempt only when literal in selected advocate words [656,669].
gate_ownership_and_projections.recovery_units: Identity/reference/graph ambiguity cannot be narrowed; _ContentFailure marks local content blocks only after graph checks. Unit peers independently preserved.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Every block/proposal/progress checked exactly once; exact selected task and target status; all semantic subchecks dominate overall acceptance; law-dependent accepted block requires actual selected checked passage; question resolution cannot fabricate missing writer update.
gate_ownership_and_projections.partial_contract: Retained subset must have rejection, no wrong selected scope, no proposal owners/legal dependencies, accepted factual+limitation blocks and nonempty certification reason. Empty subset needs empty reason; flat verdict schema exposes partial metadata on accept, but code rejects contradictory populated metadata.

gate_ownership_and_projections.gate: Only mechanically validated + semantically accepted/certified units resolve exact stored references.
gate_ownership_and_projections.projection: Original prior record references are added without copy-edited quotes; accepted units ok, retained partial, absent unavailable. Verification marker certifies this flow, not saved effects or request fulfillment.
gate_ownership_and_projections.outside_scope: Atomic persistence/release confirmation belongs to caller turn/store, not these modules.

call_accounting.research: Per fitting batch: healthy 1 planning + 1 reading + 1 independent finding review where applicable. At most 2*(planning_batches+reading_batches+review_batches) brain dispatches; empty/inactive stages call zero. This is not a per-turn fixed ceiling because batching depends on atomic units/context.
call_accounting.continuation_multiunit_ceiling: 8 = 2 writers + up to 2 reviews for each writer + up to 2 final narrow reviews. This requires different valid/local-failed units; not every path can hit all branches.
call_accounting.continuation_one_unit_ceiling: 6 = first mechanically valid writer + up to 2 reviewer calls + second local-content-failed writer + up to 2 narrowed reviewer calls. No reviewer runs on a mechanically invalid writer unit.
call_accounting.provider_attempts: Not counted here. ModelPort adapter retries/degrades and configured pinned model IDs belong to parent global inventory.

static_findings.finding: Recovery policy differs for truncation by module.
static_findings.detail: Generic checked read has no OutputTruncated correction; research does; continuation writer corrects with doubled cap; continuation reviewer treats truncation as terminal ModelError.

Research preflight counts encoded schema. Generic repair and continuation writer/reviewer local preflights count system/user/output cap, excluding schema; provider-port accounting is outside this scope.

static_findings.finding: Empty finding verification is a structural no-op, not independent omission coverage.
static_findings.detail: No atoms returns default per-subject state ok/checked_items 0 with no judge call; this must not be read as checked completeness of research or material.

static_findings.finding: Semantic verdict acceptance is not mechanical effect/completion proof.
static_findings.detail: Prompt/reviewer reason about delivered scope; legal-enquiry complete-with-no-law has a concrete code check. These four files do not validate typed requested-effect fulfillment or confirm persistence.

static_findings.finding: Partial verdict metadata is still a single flat output shape.
static_findings.detail: Fully accepted units must leave retention fields empty; nonempty retained metadata on accepted unit or an empty subset with populated retained_reason costs a review correction, then unread if repeated. No silent substantive metadata repair.

static_findings.finding: Reviewer correction and final narrowed review do not append recovery-specific system sections.
static_findings.detail: Both preserve the fixed verifier prompt and add clearly named variable input; operation and tier remain unchanged.
